lessons.text: When a spec requires preserving existing animation/transition behavior unchanged and the repo has no visual-regression tooling, flag it as a spec-precision gap instead of accepting the author's audit note alone; verify only by confirming no animation-API touches in the diff, and note that this is not equivalent to an executed regression test.
